modes.cue_notes: Ground hands and feet, lift the hips high and back to form an inverted V, pressing the chest toward the thighs and pedaling the heels to warm up the calves and hamstrings.

breathing_cues.entering: Exhale to lift the hips up and back, pressing evenly through both hands and grounding the heels toward the floor.
breathing_cues.holding: Inhale to lengthen the spine, exhale to draw the chest toward the thighs and settle deeper into the fold.
breathing_cues.exiting: Exhale to bend the knees and step or float forward to the front of the mat, or lower to the belly.

prop_free_variation: Bend the knees generously and keep the heels lifted if hamstrings or calves are tight.
